scope:
Extract original H2 connection SETTINGS and the initial connection window.

Only connection-level numeric protocol parameters and source/event anchors are
exported. No headers, bodies, URLs, credentials or original profile are used.
limits: All logged client SETTINGS in these five pinned captures agree, including the separately labelled forced-H2 diagnostic.
These numeric fields/order and initial connection WINDOW_UPDATE are observed, not all H2 frame bytes or HPACK/TLS fingerprints.
Connection window starts at the standard HTTP/2 value65535; the retained original delta establishes its new size.
Response flow-control update thresholds, later frames, priority scheduling and other installed builds remain separate.
No Dart implementation supplies expected values; no process/profile/account/network execution.
